hook: Spending four minutes finding a ball I never hit this far.
beats: Mulligan: It's right here somewhere, I swear.
setting: Wading through tall, wispy rough grass up to their chests, trees just behind, full framing.
action: Mulligan parts the long grass insisting the ball is near, then lifts his oversized bucket hat and the ball rolls right out of it onto the grass; Birdie stares as Mulligan freezes.

dialogue.speaker: Mulligan
dialogue.line: It's right here somewhere, I swear.

sound: rustling grass, a soft ball thud, a sheepish gurgle
judge: Ball in the hat reveal is a genuinely funny baby-specific surprise.
